The '''Januul camp''' was a native tribal camp, extensive and mobile, pitched by the [[Januul]], an [[Alwari]] [[overclan]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. Like many other Alwari clans, the Januul nomads could efficiently disassemble their camp, as needed, and move around Ansion.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Skirmish between the Borokii and the Januul|skirmish]] with their [[Borokii]] overclan rival took place outside this camp.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
